title: FACTION MEMORY PASS SHOWCASE
description: The change is pitched as onboarding, but it quietly rewires what the team thinks a beginner is worth. NPCs now remember a handful of faction choices and respond with small grudges instead of universal politeness. Boss intros and failure states now create cleaner moments for streams, trailers, and context-free yelling.
consequence: The world developed a memory just large enough to be inconvenient. Marketing finally found footage that did not require a glossary.

title: FACTION MEMORY PASS FOUNDATION
description: The update makes the game easier to explain from the outside, with consequences for those still inside. NPCs now remember a handful of faction choices and respond with small grudges instead of universal politeness. Several improvements focus on crash fixes, save safety, and boring reliability instead of visible beats.
consequence: The world developed a memory just large enough to be inconvenient. The game improved in ways that make terrible thumbnails.

title: NARRATIVE COMPRESSION SPRINT SHOWCASE
description: The change softens one part of the product while sharpening another part that can be measured. Side stories now resolve faster so players can return to reward tracks before the mood becomes measurable. Boss intros and failure states now create cleaner moments for streams, trailers, and context-free yelling.
consequence: The kingdom's grief was preserved as a tooltip and two currencies. Marketing finally found footage that did not require a glossary.
